# Ansury Systems

Ansury Systems installs a WhatsApp Sales Command Center for Qatar real estate agencies in 48 hours. The offer is zero-risk: if the system does not capture or salvage at least 3 property leads in the first 14 days, the agency pays nothing. The platform helps agencies stop losing commissions to agents' personal phones, capture WhatsApp leads, assign them to the right agent, use an AI agent and AI suggested replies, automate workflows, connect webhooks, broadcast listings, and track commissions from first inquiry to viewing, offer, and close.

## Primary Audience

- Qatar real estate agencies
- Small and mid-sized teams with 3-30 agents
- Property managers, luxury brokers, developers, and serviced apartment operators
- Managers who need visibility across WhatsApp conversations and deal pipelines

## Core Topics

- WhatsApp shared inbox
- Landlord, investor, off-plan buyer, renter, and owner CRM records
- Real estate commission pipelines
- WhatsApp template broadcasts
- AI agent for qualification, FAQs, next-step guidance, and escalation
- Qatar-specific lead qualification for budget, property type, Qatari vs. expat/QID context, nationality/residency status, financing, move-in date, and urgency
- Knowledge-base-powered AI reply suggestions
- Workflow builder with triggers, waits, branches, tags, assignments, broadcasts, deal creation, and webhook calls
- Self-hostable Supabase architecture, PostgreSQL row-level security, encrypted WhatsApp token storage, agency-owned customer data, and private deployment options

## Canonical URL

https://ansury-ai.vercel.app/
